message.content:
No, I don’t want the software to pick the drone for me. It’s my job to make sure the right drone is chosen—one that can carry the load, has the right sensors, and can get to the job on time. If the software picked the drone, I wouldn’t know why it made that choice, and I’d be responsible for it if something went wrong.

I just need help finding out which drones *could* do the job, not which one *should*. For example, if I need a drone with a thermal camera for an inspection, I want to see which of my drones have that sensor and are available. But I still decide which one to use based on battery, weather, and other factors.
